name: RadioGroup
description: Chooses exactly one option from a small set, with native radios in a fieldset. Default, cards and segmented (joined buttons) layouts, vertical or horizontal.

props.name: options
props.description: The options: strings, or { value, label, description, meta, disabled } objects.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled group.

props.name: label
props.description: The group label, rendered as the fieldset's legend.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the options, linked to the group with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the group invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the group invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every option. An option's own disabled disables only that one.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the group required and shows the required mark in the legend.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stacks the options or lays them in a row. Emitted as data-orientation.

props.name: variant
props.description: Plain radios, bordered cards for options with a description or price, or joined segmented buttons (the old Livewire group). Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { item: '…', itemText: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The group: legend, items, hint and error.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the legend. Hidden from screen readers; the radios are required.

parts.name: items
parts.description: The options, stacked or in a row.

parts.name: item
parts.description: One option. The whole item is the radio's label, so a card is clickable anywhere.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The visible circle. The native radio covers it.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native radio, visually hidden over the box. Attributes other than class land on every radio.

parts.name: itemDescription
parts.description: Supporting text under the option's label, linked with aria-describedby.

parts.name: itemMeta
parts.description: A price or other figure on a card.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The selected value changed. React and Vue pass the option's value as given; Livewire gives the string.

keyboard.action: Moves focus into the group, to the checked radio or the first one.
Moves to the next option and checks it (platform behavior), following the text direction.
Moves to the previous option and checks it, following the text direction.

requirements: Native input type=radio elements sharing one name, in a fieldset with a legend, so the platform supplies the radio group role, roving focus and arrow keys.
Arrow keys follow the text direction under RTL (native behavior); the dot and cards mirror with logical properties.
Every radio has a name: the given name, else the control id, so arrow keys move between the options.
Hint and error are linked to the fieldset with aria-describedby; invalid sets aria-invalid on each radio.
An option's description is linked to its radio with aria-describedby.
Visible focus ring on the box (or the segment) while its radio has :focus-visible.
Disabled uses --apui-surface-sunken and --apui-text-disabled, never opacity alone.
Use Select for more than about six options.

parts.hint: You can change plans at any time.
